parent_objective: retrospectively test whether route-screen v2 would reject M549 selected checkpoint before public eval

public_gates: evaluate L0, L2, original L3, and M549 selected L3 on a public-neutral route distribution
use at least 64 episodes and obstacle/collision/margin metrics from autodrift.evaluate
apply M551 route-screen v2 rule without public frozen-source rows
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M550 public frozen-source rows as selection data
do not change route-screen v2 thresholds after seeing retrospective result
do not promote checkpoint from route-screen evidence
hypothesis: A stronger public-neutral route-screen v2 should reject the M549 selected checkpoint before public frozen-source diagnostics, preventing the M550 failure pattern.
success_criteria: route-screen v2 artifacts compare all four checkpoints on the same route seeds
decision clearly states whether M549 selected checkpoint would have been rejected
failure is classified if route-screen v2 still admits the public-failing checkpoint
failure_criteria: screen lacks L0 and L2 references

commands.name: route_screen_v2_retrospective
commands.command: Evaluate L0/L2/original-L3/M549-selected-L3 on a 64-episode public-neutral route screen and apply M551 route-screen v2 rule.

decision_rule: M552 is a process gate. It validates or rejects the route-screen v2 workflow before more L3 repair training.
